name: mwccgap
notes: Pure-Python (stdlib) source copy in src/. The real MWCC compiler is proprietary and not included; test.sh drives the full INCLUDE_ASM transplant pipeline with fake-mwcc.py (own stand-in compiler emitting a MWCC-shaped little-endian MIPS ELF) and the decomp.wtf binutils-mips assembler (or MIPS_AS / mips-linux-gnu-as), checks the disassembly, the missing-.s error path and the 16 upstream unit tests. Not tested against real MWCC output. License: see src/LICENSE.
